name: Kaká
quote: I belong to Jesus.
testimony: After surviving a severe swimming pool accident at age 18 that could have left him paralyzed, Kaká dedicated his life and career to Christ. He famously wore the 'I Belong to Jesus' undershirt during major victories — the 2002 World Cup and the 2007 Champions League final. Football was his platform, but Christ was always his purpose. He once said: 'I play for God, not for the millions who watch me.'
bibleText: I have been crucified with Christ. It is no longer I who live, but Christ who lives in me.

name: Alisson Becker
quote: If you have God, you have everything.
testimony: Brazil and Liverpool's world-class goalkeeper is openly, boldly vocal about his Christian faith. After a heartbreaking injury in 2019, Alisson returned to score a stunning header in a Champions League match — an event he called a miracle from God. He hosts baptisms in his swimming pool for teammates, regularly shares Scripture online, and calls his talent a gift from God to be used for His glory.
bibleText: For I am not ashamed of the gospel, for it is the power of God for salvation to everyone who believes.

name: Olivier Giroud
quote: The Lord is my shepherd. He leads me.
testimony: Giroud has Psalm 23 tattooed in Latin on his arm. He credits decades of professional success to consistent daily prayer. 'When I'm on the pitch, I play for the Lord,' he said after France's 2018 World Cup win. Giroud is actively involved in Christian charities across France and has hosted faith talks for young players across Europe.
bibleText: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.

name: Bukayo Saka
quote: It's about having faith in God's plan.
testimony: After missing the decisive penalty in Euro 2020 and facing horrific racist abuse online, Saka turned to his Bible and his faith. He publicly thanked God for getting him through his darkest moment, stating: 'I know who I am, I know what I believe, and I'm not ashamed.' He carries his Bible to every major tournament and credits God for his revival and success at Arsenal.
bibleText: Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer let your requests be made known to God.

name: Declan Rice
quote: My faith keeps me grounded.
testimony: Known for his incredible work ethic and deep humility, Declan Rice has spoken about how his quiet personal faith guides his career choices and daily actions. When England's elite clubs were competing for his signature, he famously credited God for giving him the wisdom to make the right choice. His teammates describe him as a man of rare character and peace.
bibleText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding.

name: Thiago Silva
quote: God is my defender.
testimony: As a young player in Russia, Thiago Silva contracted tuberculosis — a disease that nearly took his life. Doctors gave him little hope. He clung to God through months of isolation and illness, and miraculously recovered to become one of the greatest defenders in world football history. He has never forgotten that miracle: 'God saved me twice — once from TB, and once when Brazil needed me.'
bibleText: The Lord is my rock and my fortress and my deliverer, my God, my strength, in whom I will trust.

name: Romelu Lukaku
quote: I give all my glory to God.
testimony: Lukaku grew up in poverty in Belgium, where his mother sometimes couldn't afford food for the family. He credits God for transforming his life. After every goal he scores, Lukaku points to the sky in gratitude. He has publicly shared that the Bible carried him through family hardship, injuries, and media criticism. 'Without God, I am nothing,' he said after scoring in the World Cup.
bibleText: With God all things are possible.

name: Paulo Dybala
quote: God always keeps His promises.
testimony: Dybala has faced multiple career-threatening injuries and setbacks, including being dropped from Argentina's squad at crucial moments. Through each low point, he has consistently spoken about trusting God's timing. He wears a cross during every match and kneels in prayer both before kickoff and after every goal. 'God wrote my story before I was born,' he shared in a faith documentary.
bibleText: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans for welfare and not for evil, to give you a future and a hope.

name: Sadio Mané
quote: I live for something greater than football.
testimony: Mané came from the tiny village of Bambali, Senegal, where he had almost nothing. He used his Champions League winner's pay to build a hospital, a school, and a mosque for his village — refusing personal extravagance. He has spoken about carrying the prayers of his people and using football as a vehicle for lifting others. A man of profound faith, humility, and generosity.
bibleText: From everyone who has been given much, much will be demanded.

name: Didier Drogba
quote: God used football to bring peace to my nation.
testimony: In 2005, after Ivory Coast qualified for their first World Cup, Drogba knelt on the pitch live on television and begged for the civil war dividing his nation to stop. It worked — a ceasefire was declared. He has said: 'I am convinced God used that moment to save lives. Football is nothing compared to human life.' He later became a UNDP Goodwill Ambassador and a symbol of faith in action.
bibleText: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

name: Samuel Eto'o
quote: I am African, I am Christian, I am proud.
testimony: One of Africa's greatest footballers, Eto'o grew up in deep poverty in Cameroon and was rejected by multiple clubs before Barcelona took a chance on him. He went on to win the treble with Barcelona and Inter Milan. He is deeply committed to his Christian faith and uses his foundation to fight poverty across Africa. He has said: 'Without God and without my mother's prayers, I would be nothing.'
bibleText: Fear not, for I am with you. I will strengthen you and help you.

name: Marcus Rashford
quote: God placed the hunger in me.
testimony: Rashford grew up in poverty in Wythenshawe, Manchester. During the COVID-19 pandemic, he launched a campaign that forced the UK government to U-turn on free school meals — feeding millions of children. He has spoken about how his faith and his mother's prayers shaped his character. 'My mum always told me God watches how you treat others. That never left me.'
bibleText: For I was hungry and you gave me food, I was thirsty and you gave me drink, I was a stranger and you welcomed me.

name: Gareth Bale
quote: God gave me this gift. I just have to use it.
testimony: Throughout his career at Real Madrid — where he won four Champions League titles — Bale consistently thanked God in post-match interviews. When he scored the iconic bicycle kick in the Champions League final in Kyiv, his first words were: 'I'm blessed.' He spoke about how faith gave him peace amid enormous pressure and media scrutiny throughout his career.
bibleText: Whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

name: Jordan Henderson
quote: Keep fighting — God sees your effort.
testimony: Throughout Liverpool's historic 2019-20 Premier League winning season, Henderson was a pillar of leadership. When his father was battling cancer, Henderson kept playing with a broken foot to honor his dad. He has spoken about the role of his faith in giving him the perseverance to lead through adversity — culminating in finally lifting the Premier League trophy beside his recovering father.
bibleText: Suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; character, hope.

name: Edin Džeko
quote: God gave me a second chance at life.
testimony: Born in war-torn Sarajevo during the Bosnian War of the 1990s, Džeko grew up amid siege and destruction. He has spoken about how his family's prayers carried them through the war, and how football became his path to healing and redemption. He is a symbol of hope for Bosnia and regularly uses his platform to speak about peace, reconciliation, and faith.
bibleText: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

name: Clint Dempsey
quote: God gave me the heart of a warrior.
testimony: Dempsey grew up in a trailer park in Nacogdoches, Texas. His family was deeply Christian, and faith shaped his relentless work ethic. He lost his sister to a brain aneurysm at a young age — a tragedy that deepened his faith rather than breaking it. He went on to become the top-scoring American in World Cup history, always pointing upward after each goal.
bibleText: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.

name: Gianluigi Buffon
quote: Even a goalkeeper needs to look up.
testimony: The legendary Italian goalkeeper has been vocal about his deep Catholic faith throughout his 25-year career. After suffering profound personal lows — including a gambling addiction he publicly confessed — Buffon described finding God as his anchor. He has given talks in Catholic schools across Italy and spoken about how faith gave him the humility to keep going after every mistake.
bibleText: Though I fall, I will arise. Though I sit in darkness, the Lord will be a light to me.

name: John Obi Mikel
quote: My strength comes from Christ alone.
testimony: Mikel's father was kidnapped and held for ransom on the day of one of Chelsea's biggest matches. Mikel chose to play — and only learned the full story after the game. He has credited only God with giving him the composure to perform under that pressure. After his father was released, Mikel wept on live television, thanking God publicly for His protection.
bibleText: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

name: Fernando Torres
quote: Football is a gift. Use it wisely.
testimony: Torres was publicly baptized as a teenager in Madrid and has been open about his Catholic faith throughout his career. When his form collapsed dramatically at Chelsea after a record transfer, he spoke about how faith kept him sane during the darkest criticism of his career. 'God knew what He was doing even when I didn't,' he said. He eventually recovered and won Euro 2012 with Spain.
bibleText: The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

name: Olivier Giroud
quote: The Lord is my shepherd. He leads me.
testimony: Giroud has Psalm 23 tattooed in Latin on his arm and prays before every match. He openly credits his longevity and success to God. He is actively involved in Christian charities and hosts faith discussions for young players in France and Europe.
bibleText: The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
